goal: NS Cloud Drive — Implement Source-Available Non-Commercial Redistribution License and Update Documentation
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Implement custom NS Cloud Drive Source-Available, Non-Commercial Redistribution License in LICENSE with free personal, educational, and internal use.
2. Prohibit commercial sale, paid redistribution, charging access fees, or unauthorized rebranding without prior written authorization from Naboraj Sarkar.
3. Require strict author attribution and copyright notice preservation across all distributions and community forks.
4. Explicitly declare that the license is source-available and not an OSI-approved open-source license.
5. Update README.md with license badge, plain English summary, and required Questions, Suggestions, and Contact section.
6. Update CONTRIBUTING.md with contributor licensing agreement.
7. Update About dialog in src/NSCloudDrive.ps1 preserving 0 non-ASCII encoding rules.
8. Commit and push every single file individually to GitHub per user requirement.

decisions.decision: Implement custom NS Cloud Drive Source-Available License instead of standard OSI open-source licenses (MIT/GPL/Apache).
decisions.rationale: Matches owner's explicit intention: software is freely accessible to download, inspect, study, and use, but prevents commercial exploitation, resale, or rebranding under third-party names without permission.

decisions.decision: Commit and push each file individually per explicit user instruction.
decisions.rationale: Maintains a granular, transparent commit and push history on GitHub with a 1:1 mapping between file change and push event.

decisions.decision: Add real-world Windows 11 Explorer multi-drive mounting screenshot to README and User Guide; scale logo to compact header.
decisions.rationale: Directly proves to prospective users and developers that NS Cloud Drive mounts Google Drive and TeraBox natively as Windows Explorer drives with authentic icons and live capacity bars.

decisions.decision: Formalize v1.0.0 Official Release closure. All subsequent features, optimizations, and provider additions (such as Proton Drive) transition to v1.1.0 Next Releases roadmap.
decisions.rationale: Owner officially signed off on v1.0.0 production deployment.

reviewFindings.findings: All legal terms verified; third-party notices untouched; encoding compliance strictly maintained (0 non-ASCII bytes in NSCloudDrive.ps1); links verified; contact email verified.
